question: herSTART, an initiative implemented by the Gujarat University Startup and Entrepreneurship, was launched by ______ in October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is **President Draupadi Murmu**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• President Droupadi Murmu on 4th Oct 2022 launched ‘herSTART’, a startup platform for women entrepreneurs created by Gujarat University in Ahmedabad.
 
• This initiative will link women entrepreneurs with various private and govt platforms.
 
• The President also inaugurated 5 high schools for tribals & 5 infrastructure projects of the education dept.
 
• This is the President’s first visit to Gujarat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Gujarat is a state along the western coast of India.
 
• Its coastline of about 1,600 km is the longest in the country, most of which lies on the Kathiawar peninsula.
 
• Gujarat is the fifth-largest Indian state by area and the ninth-most populous state.
 
• Gujarat:
 
 
• Capital: Gandhinagar
 
• Governor: Acharya Devvrat
 
• Chief Minister: Bhupendrabhai Patel
 
• Population: 6.27 crores (2013)
